heard running through all these stories through the ages.

conclusive in my view that ERIDU is Earth.

Not only that, we have etymological elements that connect the word, ERIDU, to the word
"Earth."

Both start with the Eh sound, (ours lost the sound but kept evidence in spelling that it
once had that at the beginning). Both are followed by the "r" sound. The "th" and the "d"
are commonly trans(whatever the right word is when one sound becomes another in
usage). The "d" sound often movs to a more "th" sound. We dropped the end sound as
time has passed.

So ERIDU becomes EARTH.

somebody is capable of showing me a deduced path of reason about how it is that this way
of doing research actually produces something about truth.

There is enough material in history of enterntainment to come up with just about

this to be the case here.

just isn't what makes me believe to those small and big sentient beings out there.

connects loose ends together, coming up with a fantastic story that doesn't neccessarily
have anything to do with real truth. Story being what it is, I have read tens of similar
books that are written with well researched material in hand. Every single one of them is
good enough to make me believe that there is some truth in it. Most really do have that in
them, but nevertheless stories themselves are mere fantasy. Most also have historical
facts correct, of what happened, when and with deduced reasons about why. But, history
being lost long ago those books are just speculative stories about how things might have
happened long ago.

Just my 2 cents.

reply to post by theRiverGoddess

Ok, so I’ve read the Terra Papers (at last!       )

I think I need to backtrack and admit that there is something pretty fascinating in the
whole story! Yes, I need to be hauled over the coals for trashing it when I read the first
page where it mentioned that we are ‘slaves to the aliens’. That’s what got my goat and I
thought that if this is the drift of the Terra Papers then the rest must be trash.

But on your and enigmania’s prompting (and hounding!         ) I finally got around to
reading the entire stuff. Having said that, I compared it with what I posted in a thread of
mine, Can Anyone Debunk This Theory? And heck! The parallels were pretty
uncanny! There are a few differences, of course, but then the gist is about the same,
probably as my theory doesn’t delve into too much detail.

But there are three points in the Terra Papers that I still have reservations about:

1. The statement that we belong to the ‘aliens’ and are their slaves.
2. The palace intrigues revolving around a particular ‘family’ spread over millions of years.
The time scales are too vast for anyone to have survived that long, but then they had
probably discovered the ‘fountain of perpetual youth’(?)
3. That the Earth (Erudu) was part of Tiamat that was destroyed in battle. The Earth was
probably always there, but terraformed over a period of thousands of years to sustain life
as we know it. And needless to say, this would have taken generations to accomplish.

But all said and done, there seems to be a common thread that runs through the ‘history’
of the Solar System and Earth in particular, according to the ‘theories’ of Colliers, Zac
Stichin, William Bramley, and others and what has been mentioned in the Terra Papers.

There are bound to be differences considering the plethora of sources, but there seems to
be a common theme. And that’s what makes it all the more interesting!


P.S. If you read that link to my thread, do amend one sentence which mistakenly
mentions that 'Mars was destroyed which is now the Asteroid belt' to read 'Planet X was
destroyed which is now the Asteroid belt'. That was a slip-up that went through
unnoticed!       (And needless to say this 'Planet X' has nothing to do with so called
'Niburu'!)

Cheers!

Hmmmm, I have a few issues about these Terra Papers. Remember people, we can think
for ourselves. And, someone in the front of this thread did make a good point. Anyone
can write anything they want...but that doesn't make it truth.

Arguments

CONS
1. If Marduk really had all history of EA, EN-LiL, An-u, and Zu Zu destroyed and our
memories purged then why are there still records of such things still in existence. For
example, how is it that myths of Zeus exist. And further more, if Zu Zu's empire was
totally disintegrated, as the Terra Papers suggest then how do we have writings of such
things today (Homer's stories)

2. I happen to work in the field of electronics. I can promise you that cell phones, head
phones and laptops do NOT alter our way of thinking in anyway except for allowing us to
phones and laptops do NOT alter our way of thinking in anyway except for allowing us to
be better connected to a world of information that WE have formed.

3. How can anyone believe that the eventual ending of evolution is humanoid? We have
been finding fossils of Great White Sharks that are millions of years old. So, this tells us
that the Great White Shark has not changed for several million years ... he STOPPED
evolving most likely because he has reached a form that is perfect for his environment. As
well, several billion species of insect also have not changed in well over 60 million years.

4. The 'electronic blanket' notion is also a little difficult to believe considering that we've
had satellites in orbit around other planets in our system, taking pictures, and
transmitting them back to Earth. Wouldn't it stand to say that these other beings could
easily place clues for us on other planets and moons for us to observe? I'll admit that the
pictures could be altered or blocked by people at NASA or the government...but other
nations also have space programs.

5. Next of all, if the RRR and the ASA-RRR empire were such great warriors (who eat the
flesh of the enemy on the battle field, feared by the SSS) then why haven't they just
simply landed a crap load of ground troops and plastered the "Greys"? Sounds like they
could very easily just come down and fix the problem without re-destroying the planet.

PROS
1. Yes, it is believable that we may have been servants to ET's in the past. We see images
of such things in everything from ancient cultural stone tables ( S. American Mayan and
Egypt ) to renaissance art work. More likely than Greys controlling us all today is the fact
that we, as a species, have become technologically advanced and now are less likely to
serve or be controlled. With the advent of computer technology, atomic power, scalar

Introduction to The Terra Papers
by Amaterasu

Robert Morning Sky, whose Hopi grandfather was amongst a group who saved an alien
from a UFO crash (before the Feds got there) in the 1940’s, was given this story to tell.
Sadly, there are pages missing and it would seem that there is much more to this story
than even the missing pages couldn't account for, but what information Morning Sky does
give us in The Terra Papers is a good place to start in understanding the reality of our
Universe…

When I first read the Terra Papers I nearly quit somewhere around page 25. “What does
all this have to do with our reality?” I asked myself. It all seemed to be so much science
fiction. Sure, I knew a bit about Sumerian “mythology” to make connections, but it kept
fiction. Sure, I knew a bit about Sumerian “mythology” to make connections, but it kept
sounding like someone’s interpretation of myth and fanciful story construction, rather
than anything meaningful in today’s world.

What kept me reading was the knowledge that this story was (presumably) given to the
Hopi Indians half a century or so ago. Robert Morning Sky seemed so earnest in recounting
what his grandfather was given, and the tale was not written as I would expect a story-
teller to write it. There were typos, skipped words, misspellings, and other flaws that lent
an authenticity to the work.

And so, I read on.

By the time I got to page 45, I began to put many things together. And the further I read,
the more my Universe made sense. There were so many questions I had been asking WHY
about in my life, and with this new paradigm, they all made sense.

My first big WHY had been the “war” on marijuana. Having researched not only the plant
itself and its effects on those who used it, but also the costs to society that its illegality
posed, I was completely mystified as to why there was any issue with it at all, and why we
accept the price we are paying in terms of the hunting, arresting, processing, trying and
incarcerating our citizens. And we are accepting the hidden costs as well: people with
felonies on their record and all the attendant issues that brings; children ripped from
loving homes (marijuana promotes loving and accepting behavior) to be neglected,
confused and abused by the system they are thrust into; disenfranchisement of the
convicted (in some states); time ripped from people’s lives wherein they are used as slave
labor in the prison-industrial complexes… And WHY is there such a phenomenal effort to
keep this drug illegal, with misinformation churned out in the guise of Public “Service”
Announcements?

And WHY are the majority – well over 70% – in this country thwarted in efforts to legalize
it so as to use it medicinally?

But by the end of reading the Terra Papers, I understood WHY.

Another WHY I had was the Codex Alimentarius – a document which calls all nutrients
“toxins.” To follow the mandates of this insane document would starve billions. A human
heart could not have thought this was appropriate.

WHY is Monsanto allowed to take over seed, foist the unknown quantity of genetic
modification onto our food supply, and awarded judgments in their favor when their
genmod crops contaminate the organic crops nearby?

WHY, again I asked, were there 600 plus empty FEMA prison camps in the United States?
This is probably the most disturbing piece of knowledge I have. That we already house 25%
of the world’s incarcerated with only 5% of the world’s population is horrendous enough –
the total we incarcerate as of this writing is a little over 2 million individuals. Though we
are scrabbling for more prison space (as if we don’t lock up enough people!), there sit
these empty prisons that can house a (low) estimate of ten times the number we have
behind bars now: twenty million! And there are rumors that underground facilities also
exist, leading one to guess that maybe a hundred million or more could be locked up.

What human-hearted thing might we expect that would require even twenty million to be
imprisoned? The whole of Mexico sneaking across our borders?

And on top of this, there are, within some of these prisons, rail cars that can shackle 150
humans at a time! Again… What could we possibly need with hundreds or even thousands
of these rail cars?

No human heart would do these things. But there they are, ugly and impending.

If, however, we accept the story the Terra Papers gives us, all these things – and many
others that might leave one scratching one’s head – make complete sense.

So I leave the reader with this: read past page 25, read past page 45. Read the whole of
both parts 1 and 2. Though pages are missing, and the story is hard to follow at points,
once you have read these fully, maybe your WHYs will be answered too.

A Closing Discussion of the Terra Papers
by Amaterasu

There are many questions left unanswered in these Papers. Many, many, in fact. Here I
will list ones we might want to contemplate, and ask of those who could answer us –
should we encounter them.

What was the purpose of the dinosaurs? Was that an SSS-T experiment…or something else?

Is the Ninth Passageway a naturally occurring wormhole?

significance of the black pig?

What is the significance of “AI” (evil eye), mentioned in the list of derived Egyptian words
but not mentioned in the text?

enemy”)?

planet or solar system?

Was the beast originally demonstrated by NIN-HUR-SAG Neanderthal?

There are other questions, to be sure, and the reader may have some I failed to bring up.

to ascend!

Let me begin this by saying that I am a member of this site but I haven't posted in quite a
while. I've got my own 'hidden history' in a book of usernames and passwords which I've
misplaced. I do need to unearth that or make a new name. In any case I am familiar with
the community here and read off and on.

I have read both books of the Terra Papers and it was a most interesting read. I do have a
few issues with it though. (I have read all the comments here also.)

Someone mentioned that some of RMS's info/sim thoughts weren't around until recently.
Wasn't Von Daniken 70's? And ancient history is widely known and has been since... well at
least since the Rosetta Stone discovery. This story reminds me very much of EVD's works
too.

I'm reminded of my own study of comparative religions ca. 1980. We studied all of these
things in school, in fact I remember learning very specific details of ancient societies in art
history even. RMS was supposedly a Theology student, yes? The study of Theology
encompasses much more then the Christian religion - one would study all religions, history,
ethics, philosophy. And I can't see how a professor would have rejected it as 'blasphemous'.
That right there makes no sense to me. A professor might have rejected this as it's not
based on formal research, but not for the subject matter.

Another thing I find hinky is this idea of 'Passion'. Now I take this as a non sexual thing - a
"zest" if you will - since he addresses mating separately. According to him - some obscure
bird like race gave a strand of DNA containing this 'passion' as a gift to EA and he gave it
to the Humans. I'm having trouble with this because - where did all these other "Alien
races" get their "passion" for war then? And if we were made with this EA's blood, who
seemed to be pretty passionate about everything - wouldn't we already have this "passion"
then?

Regarding this material being "forbidden", RMS's life has been threatened, etc. Well
couldn't that just be a sales tactic? Granted - it is "free" - but it appears he does make
money off this indirectly. Perhaps this is his 'loss leader'. Maybe all the 'secrecy' surrounding
this is just a publicity tactic. (The 'missing pages' could be part of this ploy as well.)

As far as all the terms lining up to ancient words - well - we all know mystery writers start
with the ending and work backward, yes?

I too am having problems with the electrical fields and cell phones. I thought to myself-
RMS's grandfather would likely have died before cell phones were invented. You'd think he'd
have said "radio tubes" for that era. And from that angle - if he got this info from his
Grandfather, whom was told it by the Alien in 1947 - where did all his recent info - the
JFK, Bush stuff come from?

Another issue is the timing of Alien warriors and power plays in relation to our own
history. It seems thousands of years pass but the same Alien rulers or at best their children
are then fighting with earth beings thousands of years ahead. (of course these beings
could live much longer then us, I suppose.)

There are too many logic gaps here that I can see. And it borrows from many things
presented elsewhere - such as the pyramids being electrical conductors. All the 'same old
thing'. Why not discuss the pyramids and civilizations in the Americas? Mayans, Aztecs etc.
You'd think Native Americans would be more able to relate to that and they're supposedly
You'd think Native Americans would be more able to relate to that and they're supposedly
connected into UFOlogy also. And its just too "human" of a story. Kind of commits the
Anthropomorphic Fallacy.

Its quite interesting but in my opinion there's an awful lot of logic flaws in it.

Just some food for thought and perhaps my questions can be explained as well.

Thanks for the wonderful read in any case!

I'll be back on as a 'regular' soon.

belief is: 1. what is held to be true; something beliefed; opinion 2. an acceptance as true

faith is: 1. a believing without proof; trust 2. belief in God, religion, or spiritual things 3.
what is believed 4. a religion 5. a being faithful; loyalty

Doing a bit of research, it doesn't seem other AmerIndians think very highly of "Robert
Morning Sky" or his "Terra Papers," outright calling the man a fraud and a hoaxer. This is
from a website dedicated to exposing fakes and frauds exploiting American Indians and
American stereotypes of them.

    
    Since the 1970s, a man calling himself Robert "Morning Sky" has posed as Hopi
    and Apache and made his living off of the fringes of the UFO movement...In fact,
    Morning Sky's ludicrous and goofy beliefs do not have the slightest proof.
    Morning Sky has a long history of lying and working with numerous other
    charlatans and spiritual exploiters. Even his
    very identity is open to question...



They break down some of Morning Sky's claims. In brief... (more detail on the site)

    

    1) Morning Sky is NOT Hopi.

    2) Morning Sky is likely NOT Apache. He has consistently refused to name which
    of the Apache bands he is supposedly from.

    3) Most of what Morning Sky claims are Hopi beliefs and prophecies obviously
    have NOTHING to do with Native people AT ALL. They are from CHRISTIAN or
    EUROPEAN lore.

    4) Morning Sky works with a long list of OTHER notorious frauds and
    spiritual exploiters.

    5) The Hopi Nation says NO ONE who claims to represent or teach about their
    beliefs off reservation is legitimate.

    6) Morning Sky also conducts vision quests (which are NOT a Hopi ceremony).

    7) Morning Sky's claims that there are Hopi hieroglyphics on alien autopsy sites
    are FRAUDULENT.

inches high of just referenced quotes and research I did from and about other
researchers... As an aside I found by doing this that most ex-military people speaking out
had experienced abductions (mind control?) and coincidentally most abductions happened
very near a military base in the US. I also researched more in depth into the abduction
phenomena (which I called Grey Date Rape) in my synopsis.

(two years) in Arizona and did several field trips to the Canyonlands and Chaco Canyon,

tourists will never see). I do have some photos of them. I have previewed every interview
possible from anyone deep into the research or a possible whistle blower. I have scoured all
religions (actually that was my first step when I was 16), I'm now in my 50's, for their
truths and commonalities and it always comes down to EA, somewhere, somehow....

And yes, I've even read books like you referenced above, science books. You can look at
our history on any level and get answers - the challenge is to go "beyond" and get the real
answers. Problem is most people aren't open-minded enough to look further for many
reasons...

Does that answer your question? It doesn't make me "right", it makes me "informed" at
worst. Is the Terra Papers exactly accurate? Mostly likely not - but the real question is not
its total accuracy, but does it accurately depict a likely scenario for us humans? And to
that I say, Yes, I believe it does...

I noticed one issue on initially scanning through these texts, within the section labelled as
pages 41-50 it mentions that following the wiping of 'the beasts' mind and escape of
previous rulers that the escaped rulers left us clues. Then contained within brackets it
states two examples of these clues are "(The 'Face on Mars' and the 'Domed Cities of the
Moon' are two examples)."

Clearly people state that NASA could in actual fact be feeding us false information since
the initial public Mars photography, which would force me to draw this conclusion. But,
given the higher resolution photography of the proposed Face on Mars it appears as if the
face is nothing more than one of the inevitable apparently recognisable feature.

The higher resolution photography clearly show it only resembles a face from certain
angles due to lighting and poor quality of images. If these newer pictures are real, that
suggest the face is merely a natural formation, resulting in this story being false, or the
author made a mistake in attributing the Face as a piece of evidence left behind for 'the
Beasts.'

Also concerns me with the amount of information that attempts too tie in with the Bible's
texts, just leaves me with a feeling that it's a well constructed story purposely attempting
to draw in western believers.

Definitely in line with what I'm talking about... There's always Moore's Law, which
describes the progress of technology as exponential and can actually be applied to many,
many types of systems. It describes the decreasing size of transistors over time, the rate
of population growth, the ratio of DNA sequenced to total DNA of the human genome over
time during the Human Genome Project, etc. Perhaps it also applies to self-awareness,
and awareness in general? That would mean that our society and race (and any other)
progress in this way, regardless of whether we are being spiritually enslaved or not.

I guess another way of putting it is that any system not in equilibrium (or unity?) will
develop exponentially over time towards equilibrium or unity from its current point. Since
most information-technology systems develop according to Moore's Law (at least, as far as
I know they do), we can look to see which systems have not developed according to
Moore's Law and perhaps say that those systems have external factors affecting their
development - either helping or hindering. Maybe we can see where there has been a
stifling or hiding of the truth... You'd need a ton of data to learn anything really
meaningful about global-level self-awareness and I have no idea where to find such data,
or how to quantify things like awareness. Hmm... Maybe one could use the amount of raw
information/data on the internet? Like, total number of bits on the internet over time?

I'm thinking also now about black ops technology, so I'll just tack on these ideas I'm having.

Everything progresses exponentially from its current state. That is to say, if we quantify
technological development (perhaps the size of transistors), we would find an exponential
relationship over time. Moore's Law really is a law; it describes systems very accurately. So
when we see that public sector technology/knowledge has developed according to Moore's
Law, that means it has existed in isolation. But because black ops type tech and
knowledge are several technological generations ahead of public sector, I feel perhaps that
there was an externally caused leap in knowledge. If the black ops tech was developed in
isolation, without external factors, it would not be nearly as far ahead. Public sector tech
is far behind black ops tech, because at one point in time, the black ops tech experienced
an externally caused jump in tech allowing it to get so far ahead of public sector.

It could be that public sector tech was stifled or not allowed to continue as it should, and
It could be that public sector tech was stifled or not allowed to continue as it should, and
that black ops tech has merely followed Moore's Law without any external help. But I think
there is evidence to show that black ops tech has/had access to information and
technology not of this planet, thus breaking the isolated development and allowing Moore's
Law to be violated.

Sorry if that sounds scrambled - trying to work through my own train of thought. Modeling
systems with Moore's Law can yield very interesting info and indicate whether a system
has progressed naturally or had a helping/hurting hand. None of this seems really
important though, just speculation on a difficult-to-organize experiment to get some data

I just read the Terra Papers recently, and while it all sounds pretty fantastic, it seems to
conflict with other info I've been following.

The Terra Papers jive well with ancient Sumerian mythology, such as with Enki and Enlil,
which paved the foundation for most modern religions. However I'm also a fan of the "Ra
Material", and accounts from such philosphers/occultists as Helena Blavatsky. I mean, if
you read the Ra Material and the Terra Papers back to back, obviously the Ra Materials
paints our origins as something very multi-dimensional, where as the Terra Papers
describes a very physical reality. In my opinion, the multi-dimensional approach seems to
correspond with things such as Astral Travel and modern quantum physics.

The Terra Papers or the Ra Material, which do you find yourself putting more faith in?
